key_risks.title: Gate 1 queue, zero triggers
key_risks.body: Nscale's £2bn Loughton AI campus (50 MW phase one, 90 MW max) sits at Gate 1 in the UK connection queue with no operational curtailment history (tenor_mismatch 4/4). Pre-energisation CAR/DSU is the assumed stack — no Parametrix, Descartes or NDBI availability product is evidenced (trigger_gap 4/4, product_fit 0/4). Lawful DNO/TSO curtailment or energisation slip past the Q4 2026 target idles GPU load without a damage trigger.

key_risks.title: Exposure ahead of preparedness
key_risks.body: Margin of safety −42.8 — exposure 67.8 vs preparedness 25.0 on a greenfield asset with no DCIM telemetry (data_monitoring 1/4) and no curtailment-pricing methodology (pricing_modelling 1/4). Nvidia/Dell-backed capital (capital_reinsurance 2/4) funds delivery but does not substitute for absent availability triggers on a 98 MW east-England boundary node (aggregation_correlation 3.8/4, HHI 1.0).

key_risks.title: Single Essex boundary node
key_risks.body: Entire UK book concentrates on one UKPN Loughton site — book_concentration 3/4 with register-derived HHI 1.0 on the east_england constraint boundary. A regional curtailment event hits the full 98 MW campus in one correlated loss; DNO ECR shows only 0.2% flexible-connection share (non_firm_intensity 0/4 measured) but queue-position risk remains assessed until firm energisation lands.

key_risks.title: 8 km cable SPOF
key_risks.body: LON1's 80 MVA supply depends on a bespoke ~8 km 132 kV cable route from two UKPN substations — a dig-in, joint failure or cable fault blacks both LON1A and LON1B without damaging NTT-owned plant. Standard BI responds only if proximate physical damage occurs to insured assets (trigger_gap 4/4); no cable-route parametric or NDBI product is evidenced (product_fit 1/4).

key_risks.title: Dual buildings, one feed
key_risks.body: Both 32 MW buildings share the same dedicated UKPN connection — aggregation_correlation 3.8/4 (HHI 1.0 on east_england boundary). A UKPN-side outage on the shared feed simultaneously idles 64 MW IT load; engineering resilience (N+1 UPS, dual A/B paths) scores data_monitoring 3/4 but does not create an insurance trigger for grid-originating events.

key_risks.title: Firm link, no parametric
key_risks.body: Firm UKPN connection with only 2% ECR non-firm share (non_firm_intensity 0/4 measured) — sidelined quadrant (59.0 exposure, 52.5 preparedness). NTT Corporation parent capital (capital_reinsurance 4/4) and mature DCIM outrun cover-structure gap: long-life 64 MW campus (tenor_mismatch 4/4) underwritten against near-zero published curtailment-loss history on this feed.

key_risks.title: 28% non-firm at GW scale
key_risks.body: NESO/ECR register pull shows 54.1/191.3 MW (28%) on flexible/non-firm terms at the Cambois node (non_firm_intensity 2.1/4 measured) — one of the highest infirm shares in batch10 DC assets. A 720 MW IT / ~1.1 GW site load on conditional grid access faces lawful curtailment without equipment failure; damage-only pre-construction cover is the assumed stack (trigger_gap 4/4).

key_risks.title: Pre-COD trigger vacuum
key_risks.body: Early-construction GW AI campus with no operational DCIM (data_monitoring 1/4) and no parametric grid-availability or NDBI product on asset or sponsor (product_fit 0/4). ~£10bn decade-plus phased build (tenor_mismatch 4/4) vs zero operating curtailment history on a not-yet-commissioned Cambois 400 kV substation — margin of safety −45.6.

key_risks.title: Single Cambois node
key_risks.body: Entire UK QTS exposure on one Northumberland campus — book_concentration 3/4 and aggregation_correlation 4/4 (HHI 1.0). Up to 580 backup diesel generators (48 hr fuel) cited in planning provide engineering resilience but no insurance trigger for grid-lawful curtailment at GW scale; Blackstone balance sheet (capital_reinsurance 4/4) absorbs capex delay, not tenant SLA penalties.

key_risks.title: 77% curtailment, no cover
key_risks.body: Press analysis cites ~77% of Seagreen's potential output curtailed within 18 months of Oct 2023 commissioning — extreme tenor/history mismatch (tenor_mismatch 4/4 measured) on a 1,075 MW single-zone offshore asset (book_concentration 4/4). B6-linked Scottish export bottleneck drives aggregation_correlation 4/4 (HHI 1.0 on scotland boundary); no parametric curtailment or NDBI product is documented (product_fit 0/4).

key_risks.title: BM compensation ≠ insurance
key_risks.body: Constraint revenue arrives via balancing-mechanism settlements, not insurance wordings (trigger_gap 3/4). SSE/TotalEnergies JV SCADA and NESO metering provide strong telemetry (data_monitoring 3/4) but BM compensation is policy-dependent and may not mirror multi-decade project-finance yield assumptions — basis risk on any uninsured revenue shortfall beyond BM pass-through.

key_risks.title: Firm TEC, congested export
key_risks.body: NESO TEC register shows 0% non-firm share on 1,575 MW firm connection (non_firm_intensity 0/4 measured) — curtailment is structural boundary congestion, not connection infirmity. Firm gate status does not eliminate B6 export limits; investment-grade parent capital (capital_reinsurance 4/4) absorbs merchant volatility but does not substitute for absent availability-index cover.

key_risks.title: 81% non-firm BESS stack
key_risks.body: NESO TEC register shows 1,500/1,843 MW (81%) on flexible/non-firm terms at the Thurrock/Tilbury node (non_firm_intensity 2.8/4 measured) — highest infirm share among operational UK BESS in batch10. 300 MW / 600 MWh merchant revenue stack (FFR, BM, capacity) faces lawful de-dispatch without equipment failure; damage-only asset cover assumed (trigger_gap 3/4, product_fit 0/4).

key_risks.title: De-dispatch uninsured
key_risks.body: System balancing or market re-pricing can suppress dispatch value across stacked BESS services without damaging plant — no evidenced dispatch-deviation or NDBI parametric structure. Margin of safety −52.4 (exposure 86.2, preparedness 33.8); EQT-backed project finance (capital_reinsurance 3/4) with one of the largest UK BESS debt packages sits on short post-energisation curtailment history (tenor_mismatch 3/4).

key_risks.title: Single east-England node
key_risks.body: UK's largest BESS to date on one Tilbury site — book_concentration 4/4 with HHI 1.0 on east_england boundary (aggregation_correlation 4/4). Operational BMS/SCADA (data_monitoring 3/4) monitors plant health, not insurance-style curtailment certainty; co-located flexible generation at the Essex transmission node amplifies correlated constraint events.

key_risks.title: 180 MW scale-up gap
key_risks.body: Cobalt Business Park campus scales from ~30 MW live to 180 MW max on one Newcastle site (book_concentration 3/4). Rapid expansion creates under-insurance risk if declared values and BI limits are not updated phase-by-phase; no aggregate BI or curtailment rider evidenced (product_fit 0/4, trigger_gap 3/4).

key_risks.title: Firm link, no NDBI
key_risks.body: Dual-diverse 275 kV paths to Tynemouth GSP provide firm transmission (non_firm_intensity 0/4 measured, ECR 0.5%) — yet National Grid ESO balancing actions can reduce import without damaging insured plant. Tier 3+ Schneider Galaxy VM UPS and DCIM (data_monitoring 3/4) monitor on-site resilience, not grid-lawful curtailment triggers.

key_risks.title: Single Cobalt campus
key_risks.body: All live and future load on one Cobalt Business Park campus — aggregation_correlation 3.6/4 (HHI 1.0) partially mitigated by dual 275 kV feeds. Tiger Infrastructure PE backing (capital_reinsurance 2/4) with Digital9 freehold landlord wind-down adds moderate balance-sheet depth vs hyperscaler peers; sidelined quadrant (56.8 exposure, 37.5 preparedness).

key_risks.title: DNO upstream BI gap
key_risks.body: Telehouse North, East, West and North Two feed from one on-site 50 MVA dual-primary substation taking two 132 kV lines — a fault on National Grid/UKPN infrastructure upstream of insured plant blacks the campus without proximate physical damage to Telehouse assets (trigger_gap 4/4). Carrier-hotel property cover does not respond to DNO-originating outages; no parametric availability product evidenced (product_fit 1/4).

key_risks.title: One campus substation
key_risks.body: All Docklands capacity on Coriander Avenue — book_concentration 3/4 with HHI 1.0 on east_england boundary (aggregation_correlation 3.8/4). Substation-level events correlate across all buildings simultaneously; N+1 generators and ISO 22301/27001 certifications (data_monitoring 3/4) provide continuity engineering, not non-damage revenue protection.

key_risks.title: 1990 campus, thin history
key_risks.body: Docklands carrier hotel operating since 1990 with multi-decade asset life (tenor_mismatch 4/4) vs thin curtailment-loss record on this firm dual-feed. KDDI £135m further London investment (capital_reinsurance 4/4) and 0% ECR non-firm share (non_firm_intensity 0/4) — capital depth outruns trigger-structure gap on a mature but uninsured grid-firmness stack.

key_risks.title: One 400kV supergrid node
key_risks.body: All 80–148 MW critical IT load sits behind a single private 400 kV National Grid supergrid connection at Coedkernew — aggregation_correlation 3.8/4 (HHI 1.0 on south_wales boundary). A fault or extended maintenance window at the Capenhurst-area node blacks the entire 46-acre campus; book_concentration 3/4 on one Newport site.

key_risks.title: Hyperscale, damage-only cover
key_risks.body: Tier III+ concurrently maintainable hyperscale colocation with conventional property/BI cover only (trigger_gap 4/4). No Parametrix, Descartes or SLA-mirror availability product is evidenced; ESO balancing actions or planned supergrid outage windows reduce import without damaging insured plant. DigitalBridge/Silver Lake $9.2bn equity (capital_reinsurance 4/4) funds expansion, not curtailment triggers.

key_risks.title: Firm NGED, zero ECR infirm
key_risks.body: Dedicated private 400 kV link to National Grid transmission with 0% ECR non-firm share (non_firm_intensity 0/4 measured) — sidelined quadrant (66.5 exposure, 52.5 preparedness). Long-life transmission-connected campus (tenor_mismatch 4/4) vs minimal operating curtailment history at this node; close via register_pull on NGED connection status and trigger_mining on operational wordings.

key_risks.title: SSEN hotspot correlation
key_risks.body: ~120 MVA West London portfolio (LON2 Hayes + LON5–8 Stockley Park) sits on the SSEN Hillingdon constraint boundary — same Iver GSP hotspot as Equinix Slough, CyrusOne LON6 and Yondr (aggregation_correlation 3.8/4, HHI 1.0 on southern boundary). Entire Hillingdon cluster correlates to one constraint event; trigger_gap 4/4 with no parametric SSEN curtailment product evidenced.

key_risks.title: 120 MVA, zero triggers
key_risks.body: Tier III campuses with N+1 diesel (72 hr), dual A/B UPS and PUE <1.2 (data_monitoring 3/4) — engineering resilience only, no availability or parametric power-curtailment insurance (product_fit 1/4). Colocation property/asset cover does not respond to grid-lawful curtailment without equipment failure; ST Telemedia/Macquarie capital (capital_reinsurance 4/4) on sidelined quadrant (59.6 exposure, 52.5 preparedness).

key_risks.title: Tier III vs zero history
key_risks.body: West London data-centre cluster less than 20 years old with 25-year asset lives (tenor_mismatch 4/4) — near-zero published UK DC curtailment-loss history on these firm-connected sites (non_firm_intensity 0/4 measured). Actuarial pricing for grid-firmness losses remains unmodelled at asset level (pricing_modelling 1/4).

key_risks.title: B6 curtailment, BM only
key_risks.body: 539 MW onshore wind (215 turbines) on Eaglesham Moor north of the B6 Scotland–England boundary — systemic export limits repeatedly curtail output independent of turbine health (aggregation_correlation 4/4, HHI 1.0). REF analysis documents persistent constraint payments; no parametric B6-boundary availability product evidenced (trigger_gap 3/4, product_fit 0/4).

key_risks.title: Constraint pay basis risk
key_risks.body: Balancing-mechanism constraint payments offset part of curtailed output but are policy-dependent and may not mirror project-finance yield (trigger_gap 3/4). Scottish wind curtailment costs hit £343m in 2025 per industry reporting — tenor_mismatch 3/4 on 25+ year asset life vs evolving constraint regime. Iberdrola/ScottishPower investment-grade capital (capital_reinsurance 4/4) absorbs merchant volatility.

key_risks.title: 14% non-firm TEC share
key_risks.body: NESO TEC shows 89/632 MW (14%) on flexible/non-firm terms including co-located BESS rows (non_firm_intensity 1.3/4 measured) — infirm connection compounds B6 boundary congestion. Full SCADA and NESO-metered output (data_monitoring 3/4) supports constraint analytics but does not create insurance-style revenue certainty.

key_risks.title: Non-firm Slough expansion
key_risks.body: Entity analysis flags non_firm SSEN connection for the 100+ MW Slough campus — live phases (~60 MW) energised but remaining ~40 MW expansion firmness unverified under SSEN West London constraint (trigger_gap 3/4). Same Iver GSP hotspot as Equinix/CyrusOne peers; no parametric SSEN curtailment product evidenced (product_fit 0/4).

key_risks.title: 100 MW one site
key_risks.body: All live and future campus capacity on one Berkshire site — book_concentration 3/4 with HHI 1.0 on southern boundary (aggregation_correlation 3.8/4). A constraint event, SSEN outage or regional grid fault hits the full hyperscale load stack; HVO-fuelled backup generators on live phases (data_monitoring 3/4) provide engineering resilience only.

key_risks.title: Immature curtailment record
key_risks.body: First 20 MW live 2024 on multi-phase 100 MW build (tenor_mismatch 3/4) — curtailment-loss history still immature vs long asset life. DigitalBridge/CDPQ acquisition capital (capital_reinsurance 4/4) funds expansion; ECR shows 0% non-firm share on matched rows (non_firm_intensity 0/4 measured) but entity grid posture remains assessed non_firm.

key_risks.title: 59% non-firm Cheshire BESS
key_risks.body: NESO TEC register shows 2,677/4,531 MW (59%) on flexible/non-firm terms at the Capenhurst node (non_firm_intensity 2.9/4 measured) — among the highest infirm shares in batch10. 100 MW / 107 MWh BESS stacking active-power, capacity and voltage services faces lawful de-dispatch without equipment failure; damage-only project finance cover assumed (trigger_gap 3/4, product_fit 0/4).

key_risks.title: De-dispatch revenue gap
key_risks.body: ESO balancing instructions can suppress stacked BESS revenues without damaging plant — no parametric dispatch/availability product evidenced. Natural Power ControlCentre telemetry (data_monitoring 3/4) monitors dispatch, not insurance triggers; Santander £60m project finance (tenor_mismatch 3/4) with 15+ year horizon vs short constraint-revenue history. Margin of safety −58.2.

key_risks.title: PF covenant at one bay
key_risks.body: Full 100 MW concentrated at one Capenhurst 275 kV SP Energy Networks transmission bay — book_concentration 4/4 and aggregation_correlation 4/4 (HHI 1.0). Extended non-damage outage threatens debt-service covenants on Santander/£235m club finance (capital_reinsurance 2/4) with no revenue-continuity product evidenced; world-first reactive-power service adds operational complexity.
